Hi Sergio & Marissa,

- experience with PHI handling in Private/Dedicated deployments

Can either of you suggest a customer who: (a) is ok with a quick 30-min call, (b) can discuss the payor integration angle, and (c) is available next week (Nov 22–24 window)? Ideally someone in the payer or payer-adjacent space (claims ops, utilization mgmt, clinical review).

Thanks — quick replies appreciated, calling this one high priority.
